svg.text: AirMaster carrier Rev D: case, base and top
71.0 x 61.6 mm, 77.4 across the lugs. Power end up.
Three hooks hold the board against four pins.
Tape under the plate, or two #6 pan heads in the slots.
22.1 mm high. Power end at the left.
24 VAC, PGM and USB notches, left to right.
SUP, RET and 1-WIRE notches, left to right.
A. Section along the LED column, x 3.2
Twice size. Each LED in its own cell.
B. Section across at y 33, through LED Y2 and the right hook
C. Section at y 51.5, the left latch
